text: Key parameters: bin_minutes: Aggregation window minutes. Use 1440 calendar-day summaries (default). Smaller values (e.g., 60) produce sub-daily bins. offset: Time day (HH:MM) used day boundary sleep-aligned dates — timestamps time assigned next day’s sleep_date. Also passed make_offset() compute flg_30sec (30-second sleep presence indicator). offset = NULL, bin_minutes used instead. two effectively mutually exclusive. min_actv_minutes: Threshold qc_{n}min quality control flag. day passes QC min_actv >= min_actv_minutes. Passing 600 creates qc_600min; passing 480 creates qc_480min, etc. append_daily_fitbit_qc: TRUE, appends Fitbit-reported step counts computes qc_steps pcnt_steps_fitb. available bin_minutes = 1440. qc_threshold: Minimum proportion Fitbit-reported steps computed active steps must meet qc_steps pass. Defaults 0.8. qc_steps TRUE steps_actv >= qc_threshold * steps_fitb, FALSE threshold, NA steps_fitb zero missing. pcnt_steps_fitb gives underlying ratio (steps_actv / steps_fitb), set 1 values equal, NA steps_fitb zero missing. Output columns include: Identifiers: participant_id, session_id, wk, day, dt, dt_day, dt_wknd Minutes: min_total, min_actv, min_slp, min_nap_slp Steps: steps_total, steps_actv, steps, steps_fitb Intensity: mets, mets_actv, min_intnst_sed_*, min_intnst_light_*, min_intnst_mod_*, min_intnst_vigor_* (total active variants) HR exclusions: excl_min_total_actv, excl_min_lowhrate_actv, excl_min_nohrate_actv, excl_min_repeathrate_actv (sleep equivalents) QC: qc_{n}min, qc_steps, pcnt_steps_fitb Flags: flg_30sec, flg_any Day numbering: Day 0 (pre-study data) excluded output via filter(day != 0). title: Static and Dynamic Substance Use (SDSU) summary scores
text: ABCD Study collects data annual (full-year) mid-year timepoints. computing substance use summary scores, need decide handle mid-year data. algo parameter SDSU functions provides five strategies:

previous_headings: SDSU summary score functions > Strategy for dealing with mid-year sessions
title: Static and Dynamic Substance Use (SDSU) summary scores
text: NULL: mapping - keeps sessions -"next_existing_fy": Maps mid-year next existing annual session (drops terminal mid-years) "next_potential_fy": Maps mid-year next existing annual, forecasts one none exists "next_immediate_fy": Maps mid-year immediately following annual (e.g., ses-01M → ses-02A), regardless whether exists "remove_my": Removes mid-year sessions, keeping annual sessions Default Algorithm: following examples use default algo values: algo = "next_existing_fy" compute_ss_use_yn algo = NULL compute_ss_use_onset_event compute_ss_use_onset_age. use different strategy, add algo parameter function call.

title: Static and Dynamic Substance Use (SDSU) summary scores
text: Use NULL : want preserve original session structure Performing session-level analyses Use "next_existing_fy" : want conservative estimates using confirmed annual visits Terminal mid-years excluded analysis Use "next_potential_fy" : want retain terminal mid-years forecasting next annual session acceptable include data may updated future releases Use "next_immediate_fy" : want consistent mapping regardless data availability Useful imputation forecasting scenarios Use “remove_my” : want annual assessment data Mid-year data completely excluded

title: Static and Dynamic Substance Use (SDSU) summary scores
text: cumulative parameter applies compute_ss_use_yn controls whether use assessed session independently accumulated time: cumulative = FALSE (default): Returns 1 use reported session, 0 otherwise. session-level snapshot, suitable static summaries. cumulative = TRUE: Returns 1 first session use observed onward, regardless later sessions. “ever used point” view suited longitudinal dynamic analyses. cumulative apply compute_ss_use_onset_event compute_ss_use_onset_age, inherently lifetime/onset measures.

code: output <- purrr::map2(   sdsu_config |>     pull(name_score_use_yn),   sdsu_config |>     pull(substance),   \(x, y) compute_ss_use_yn(data_sdsu, x, y, cumulative = TRUE) ) |>   purrr::reduce(full_join, by = c("participant_id", "session_id"))  output |>   tidyr::pivot_longer(     -c(participant_id, session_id),     names_to = "variable",     values_to = "value"   ) |>   summarise(     no = sum(value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),     yes = sum(value == 1, na.rm = TRUE),     missing = sum(is.na(value)),     .by = c(variable, session_id)   ) |>   tidyr::pivot_wider(     names_from  = session_id,     values_from = c(no, yes, missing),     names_glue  = "{session_id}_{.value}"   ) |>   arrange(variable) |>   print(n = Inf) compute_ss_use_yn(   data_sdsu,   "combined_alc_flav__vape_lft_yn",   c("Alcohol", "Flavored Vaping Products"),   cumulative = FALSE )

text: Compute age first use marijuana Compute longest streak consecutive weeks alcohol binge drinking
code: #' Add age of use #' #' @description #' Adds an `age_use` column to the TLFB raw data based on the anonymized date of #' birth and the date of use. Age is computed in years (with decimals) using #' an exact method taking into account leap years (using functions from the #' `lubridate` package). #' #' @param data tibble. The TLFB raw data. #' @param data_dob tibble. A data frame containing at least two columns, the #'   participant ID and the anonymized date of birth. #' @param col_dob character. The name of the column in `data_dob` that has the #'   anonymized date of birth. #' #' @return tibble. The TLFB raw data with an additional column `age_use`. add_age_use <- function(data, data_dob, col_dob) {   data_dob <- data_dob |>     select(       participant_id,       dob = {{ col_dob }}     )    data |>     left_join(       data_dob,       by = "participant_id"     ) |>     mutate(       age_use = lubridate::interval(dob, dt_use) / lubridate::years(1)     ) |>     select(       -dob     ) }  # expects that a data frame `data_dob` with a column `dob_anonymized` # to be available in the global environment; uses the `add_age_use()` function # to add a column with the age of the participant at each reported use and # finds the first use of marijuana for each participant data_tlfb |>   compute_tlfb_dt(     name      = "dt_use",     substance = "Marijuana (all forms)",     period    = "detailed",     position  = "first"   ) |>   summarize(     dt_use = min(dt_use),     .by = participant_id   ) |>   add_age_use(data_dob, "dob_anonymized") |>   select(     participant_id,     mj_age_first_use_tlfb = age_use   ) #' Add week sequence #' #' @description #' Adds a `wk_seq` column to the TLFB raw data. The week sequence is computed #' based on the minimum and maximum dates of use in the data, with week 1 being #' the one that contains the minimum date of use and the maximum week number #' being the one that contains the maximum date of use. That is, the week #' sequence contains consecutive week numbers from the earliest to the latest #' possible date and works across all years contained in the data. Joining this #' week sequence to the data allows for the computation of weekly summaries and #' streaks of consecutive use weeks. #' #' @details #' The week sequence can be computed using either the `lubridate::isoweek()` or #' the `lubridate::epiweek()` command. The `lubridate::isoweek()` command uses #' the European standard for week numbering, where Monday is the first day and #' Sunday is the last day of the week. The `lubridate::epiweek()`command uses #' the US standard where Sunday is the first day of the week and Saturday is the #' last day. The default is to use the `lubridate::isoweek()` command as it does #' not break up a weekend into two different weeks. #' #' @param data tibble. The TLFB raw data. #' @param standard character. The standard to use for week numbering. One of #'   `"iso"` or `"epi"` (Default: `"iso"`; see details). #' #' @return tibble. The TLFB raw data with an additional column `wk_seq`. add_wk_seq <- function(data, standard = c("iso", "epi")) {   standard <- match.arg(standard)    week_command <- switch(standard,     iso = lubridate::isoweek,     epi = lubridate::epiweek   )    data_weeks <- tibble(     dt = seq(       min(data$dt_use),       max(data$dt_use),       by = 1     )   ) |>     mutate(       yr_use = lubridate::year(dt),       wk_use = week_command(dt)     ) |>     distinct(       yr_use,       wk_use     ) |>     arrange(       yr_use,       wk_use     ) |>     mutate(       wk_seq = row_number()     )    data |>     mutate(       yr_use = lubridate::year(dt_use),       wk_use = week_command(dt_use)     ) |>     left_join(       data_weeks,       by = join_by(yr_use, wk_use)     ) |>     select(       -yr_use,       -wk_use     ) }  data_tlfb |>   ABCDscores::filter_tlfb(     substance = "Alcohol",     binge = list("M" = 5, "F" = 4),     period = "detailed"   ) |>   add_wk_seq(standard = "iso") |>   summarize(     alc_binge = n_distinct(dt_use),     .by = c(participant_id, session_id, wk_seq)   ) |>   arrange(     participant_id,     session_id,     wk_seq   ) |>   mutate(     streak = cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(wk_seq) != 1)),     .by = c(participant_id, session_id)   ) |>   mutate(     n_wks = row_number(),     .by = c(participant_id, session_id, streak)   ) |>   summarize(     alc_wks_binge = max(n_wks),     .by = c(participant_id)   ) |>   arrange(     desc(alc_wks_binge)   )

title: ABCDscores 7.0.1
text: ss_* utility functions (ss_mean(), ss_sum(), ss_count(), ss_max(), ss_count_cond(), ss_mean_pos()) now convert non-finite values (Inf, -Inf, NaN) NA coercing input columns numeric summarization, treated like missing value. includes character values "Inf" become non-finite coercion. ss_nm(), coerce inputs, applies conversion numeric columns . numeric coercion ss_* utility functions now raises informative warning values interpreted numbers (e.g., "abc") set NA, naming affected column number values lost, instead R’s bare “NAs introduced coercion” warning. ss_* utility functions now abort requested score column name already exists input data, instead silently producing duplicated column name. ss_count_cond(combine = TRUE) now returns tibble instead base data frame, ss_tscore() combine_checkboxes() gained additional input validation. Added testthat unit test suite. covers 12 exported ss_* utility functions one--many compute functions behind TLFB, SUI, SDSU, medication (rx), family history scores, hand-derived expected values non-response code exclusion, missingness thresholds, event filtering, return types. applicable function carries regression case v6.1.0 factor--numeric coercion bug (factor codes silently converted level indices). Added Performance & scalability article package documentation, reporting reproducible single-threaded benchmark scoring functions full ABCD 7.0 tabulated release. 2,240 summary scores derivable tabulated release computed 6.5 minutes laptop (Intel Core i7-13700H), one--one one--many functions timed separately.

title: ABCDscores 7.0.1
text: compute_tlfb_maxdose() now takes maximum per-day summed doses instead individual substance rows, compute_tlfb_totdose_sum() accumulates chronological session order instead input row order. Combined-substance maximum-dose scores cumulative total-dose scores computed unsorted data change accordingly. SDSU scores: forecast terminal mid-year session now maps next annual session (e.g. ses-06M ses-07A) instead already elapsed one, compute_ss_use_onset_event() accepts character session_id columns (previously required factors errored otherwise). Documentation error messages: compute_ss_use_onset_age() roxygen now documents returned onset-age column numeric (described character), compute_famhx_endorsement() now renders intended error message columns match var_matches (variable-name typo previously surfaced cli interpolation error instead). compute_ph_y_meds_estuse_flags_all() now flags youth medications correctly. internal estimated-use engine matched category columns hardcoded ph_p_meds__ prefix, every ph_y_meds estimated-use flag returned "0" regardless reported medications. candidate columns now derived flag’s table_name (ph_p_meds results unchanged).

Added Prodromal Psychosis Scale / SIPS distress, severity, persistence, count, first-event, ever-event scores (mh_y_pps, mh_y_ppsss). Added UCLA Loneliness Scale summary scores (fc_y_lone). Added combined unit scores parent height birthweght (ph_p_anthr, ph_p_dhx). Added Native American Acculturation mean scores (fc_y_na, ab_p_demo__ntvam). Added Fitbit summary scores file-based data activity sleep daily weekly level, means, durations, counts. Added vignettes (Articles) Family History (FAMHX) summary scores, Medication use history, Static Dynamic Substance Use (SDSU) summary scores, Computing Daily Weekly Fitbit Scores.

Values 777 now excluded mh_y_peq, fc_y_fes, fc_y_vs, fc_y_pnh, fc_y_psb, fc_y_srpf; values 777 999 now excluded fc_p_fes, fc_p_vs, fc_p_psb; unnecessary exclusion criteria removed fc_y_vs__famil scores. Fixed compute_ph_y_mctq__sd_count school-data handling replace NAs 0 school/work days endorsed numeric. Fixed physical-health arithmetic factor character inputs used directly numeric calculations. Birthweight, OTBI age, parent height computations now coerce source variables numeric arithmetic comparisons. Fixed EATQ mean computations redundant recode_levels() calls alter values computing means. unwanted recoding step removed. Missingnes criteria adjust Life Events measures (mh_y_ple, mh_p_ple).
